title: Disability Compensation Restorations: Minor Children and School Children
content:
The child additions in a restoration of Disability Compensation are set by the children the award records, counted for every month the restoration covers:

- **Both minor and school children recorded:** one child addition for each recorded minor child plus one school-child addition for each recorded school child.
- **Minor children only:** one child addition for each recorded minor child.
- **School children only:** one school-child addition for each recorded school child.
- **No child recorded:** nothing.

Minor children recorded are the child additions on the award less the child removals; school children recorded are the school-child additions less the school-child removals. A restoration month priced from the 100 percent tier takes 146.10 for each minor child and 472.95 for each school child; every other restoration month takes the award's own tier.

**Illustration (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (80% Combined Rating), a month at the veteran-alone rate, one minor child and one school child recorded):** 116.88 plus 378.36, that is 495.24. For a month priced from the 100 percent tier: 146.10 plus 472.95, that is 619.05.
